title: SQL::Abstract versions before 2.000003 for Perl allow SQL injection via an arrayref column value in… (CVE-2026-121265)
description: SQL::Abstract versions before 2.000003 for Perl contain a vulnerability that allows SQL injection via an array reference used as a column value in insert and update operations. By default, the array_datatypes option is off, causing arrayref values to be treated as literal SQL, which leads to injection if untrusted input is passed. This affects insert(), update(), values(), and generate() methods, including when AUTOLOAD is enabled with allow_autoload on. This vulnerability can be exploited by passing specially crafted arrayref data, such as JSON arrays or repeated form fields decoded as arrays, resulting in unescaped SQL fragments.
